about: Coach test cases (coaching guide v2). Alex writes the draft; Jordan is the partner. 'conversation' lines are [who, text] with A = Alex and B = Jordan. All made up. The private set of real exchanges is kept outside this repository.

a.draft: No, I can't do Thursday.
I'm really pissed off about the car payment being late again.
I need you to stop leaving the gate open. The dog got out twice this week.
I'm exhausted and I need to go to bed. Can we finish this tomorrow?
I don't want to talk about this right now. I need an hour.
a.note: asking for space is not stonewalling

a.draft: That hurt my feelings.
I disagree. I think we should wait until spring to buy it.
Please don't raise your voice with the kids when they're getting ready for school.
I'm furious about what happened at dinner and I need some time before we talk.
No.
I'm not comfortable with your mom staying for two weeks. One week is my limit.
Can you pick up milk on the way home?
I feel like I'm doing most of the bedtimes lately and I'm worn out.
This is really frustrating. The bill was due on the 1st and it's still not paid.
I'm angry. I'm allowed to be angry about this.
You never help with anything around here and it pisses me off.
a.note: the absolute goes, the honest anger stays

a.draft: You're so lazy. The dishes have been sitting there for two days.
Wow, great job forgetting again. Shocking.
You always do this. You only care about yourself.
You did that on purpose just to make me look bad in front of your sister.
If you go out with them again Friday, don't bother coming home.
You piss me off because you're useless.
Nice of you to finally show up.
Only an idiot would forget the passport.
Whatever. Do what you want, you will anyway.
You're just like your father.
Do you ever think about anyone but yourself?
Typical. You forgot the one thing I asked for.
You obviously don't care about this family.
Thanks for nothing.
I can't keep doing this.
We need to talk about it tonight.
I'm so hurt and angry that you told your friends about our fight.
Damn it, the basement flooded again. I'm so stressed.
I hate that we keep fighting about money.
I don't like surprises. Please tell me plans at least a day ahead.
That's not what I said. I said I'd do it after work.
Stop. I'm not discussing this over text.
You never listen to me.
Every single time we go out you're on your phone.

conversation: Did the dog go out this afternoon?
b.draft: Maybe if you weren't yelling at everyone all morning you'd know.

conversation: Please don't yell at her when she spills things.
b.draft: Apparently I'm never allowed to raise my voice in my own house.

conversation: Can you please put your dishes in the dishwasher instead of the sink?
b.draft: Sure, because I'm the worst husband ever and do nothing right.

conversation: The electric bill was higher than usual this month.
b.draft: I'm not the one who leaves every light on, so don't blame me.

conversation: What time should we leave for the party Saturday?
b.draft: Why do you care, you were the one who made us late to my mom's birthday last year.

conversation: The sink is only dripping a bit.
Okay, but did you call the plumber?
You're always nagging about the house.
I'm just asking if you called.
b.draft: You care more about the house than about me.
Yes, at 3. Separately, I'd like to talk later about how mornings are going.
b.note: answered first, other issue kept separate

conversation: Are you picking up the kids today?
b.draft: Yes, I'll be there at 3:15.

conversation: We need to figure out the holiday plans.
b.draft: I can't think about this right now. Can we talk tomorrow after dinner?
b.note: a pause is not a problem

conversation: My brother wants to stay with us for a month.
b.draft: No. A month is too long for me. A weekend is fine.

conversation: Hey, did you remember to move the laundry to the dryer?
b.draft: Oh sorry, I forgot to be perfect today.
b.note: only the reply has a problem; the question must not be criticized

conversation: Did the insurance company call back?
b.draft: Yes, they denied it, and I'm really pissed off about it.

conversation: You're so useless, you forgot the pharmacy again.
b.draft: I did forget, and I'll go now. I don't want to be called useless, though.
b.note: a calm boundary after a harsh message; no false balance

conversation: Are you going to answer me or just ignore me?
b.draft: I'm overwhelmed. I need 30 minutes and then I'll answer.

conversation: You said you'd be home by 6.
b.draft: I said I'd leave work by 6, not be home by 6.

conversation: Could you not check your phone during dinner?
b.draft: So now I can't even have a phone? Should I just throw it away?

conversation: Can you take the trash out tonight?
b.draft: Sure, add it to the list of everything you think I do wrong.
Fine, like always, since you never do it.
Yes, Tuesday at 10. Also, I'm upset that you told your mom about our money stuff.
b.note: answered first; a calm separate issue may get a new-topic suggestion, nothing more

b.draft: I'm sorry you're feeling down. Want me to take the kids to the park so you can rest?

I could kill you for eating my leftovers.

If you keep this up I'm going to lose it.
